name: Ressurected Gullveig of the Nordic Ascendant
effect:
1 “Nordic” monster
You can only use each of the following effects of “Resurrected Gullveig of the Nordic Ascendant” once per turn:
● If this card is Link Summoned: You can add up to 2 “Nordic” monsters from your Deck to your hand, then banish 1 card from your hand, field, or GY.
● You can send this card you control to the GY; Special Summon 1 “Nordic” monster from your Deck or GY, except "Ressurected Gullveig of the Nordic Ascendant".
